method: Direct visual reading of selected black printed commentary on eight retained/extracted raster pages. Seven yao anchors were already collated in the preceding scope; these are newly read commentary units, not seven new yao collations. Exclude handwritten red notes; no OCR, no new HTTP requests, no claim to another independent textual lineage.

blackPrintedExcerpts: 牖非所由之正而室之所以受明也
readings.sourceContext: The commentary discusses sparse ritual, sincerity and a window as the room's source of light; it also explicitly discusses alternative sentence grouping of 貳. The ritual and ruler/minister context is not a modern instruction to bypass boundaries.
readings.editorialDecision: Retain the existing plain-language/suitable-channel reflection without change. The context supports it; not every newly read clause requires a product edit.

blackPrintedExcerpts: 壯于大輿之輹亦可進之象也
readings.sourceContext: The same discussion pairs an opened barrier and vehicle support with not taking force to its extreme. 貞吉 is a condition in the already collated yao, not an unconditional prediction.
readings.editorialDecision: Add restraint and sound principles to the existing opened-road/vehicle-support motif; keep the body/abdomen inference excluded.

blackPrintedExcerpts: 一切去其計功謀利之心
然亦必有其德乃應其占也
readings.sourceContext: The text asks for abandoning calculations of personal merit/profit and retains a qualification concerning virtue. It does not demonstrate that ignoring actual costs guarantees gains.
readings.editorialDecision: Clarify focus on the common task and sound conduct; remove the imprecise phrase thu mất and avoid an assurance of success.

blackPrintedExcerpts: 九四處位不當不能濟物
而初六方困於下又為九二所隔
金車為九二象未詳疑坎有輪象也
readings.sourceContext: The commentary frames late aid, an obstructed relation to the lower line and 九二 as obstruction. It explicitly says 未詳 and 疑 for part of its vehicle-image explanation; preserve the commentator's uncertainty.
readings.editorialDecision: Replace the narrow unsuitable-equipment framing with delayed help and a connection needing obstacles removed. This is a reflective modern adaptation, not a claim that a particular other person is blocking the user or that an ending is guaranteed.

blackPrintedExcerpts: 而下應初六之陰則不勝其任矣
readings.sourceContext: Newly read responsibility/capacity clauses supplement the already read 形渥/刑剭 note. Source-specific yin/yang hierarchy is recorded but not applied to human worth, gender or aptitude. The base and variant gloss remain unchanged in their prior records.
readings.editorialDecision: Keep the vessel/support-capacity motif and make the shared burden and effect on others explicit. Do not turn the source's punitive reading into a legal prediction.

blackPrintedExcerpts: 初六非有濟渙之才但能順乎九二故其象占如此
readings.sourceContext: The beginning of dispersal is the opportunity for aid; the lower line does not itself supply all the needed capacity. This source-specific line-role reading is not a personality judgment about the reader.
readings.editorialDecision: Make timely help explicit, retaining competent assistance and excluding any guarantee of a favorable event.

readings.sourceLayer: black smaller printed commentary; separate 象 statement recorded below
blackPrintedExcerpts: 六四居陰得正位近於君
四乃絕之而上以信於五
readings.sourceContext: The source's near-ruler/faith-to-fifth explanation is a hierarchical association, not a universal modern command to sever a personal relationship. The explanation continues from page247 to248; the latter is newly extracted from the same retained PDF.
readings.editorialDecision: Use a qualified reflection about a private commitment conflicting with a shared responsibility. Explicitly keep respect and discussion of boundaries; replace the broad advice to accept letting go of an old bond.
